lines.text: Anywhere but the 4th floor, dear!
The doors count us when they close. Three is lucky!
lines.textKo: 문 닫힐 때 몇 명인지 세는 거야. 셋이면 좋지!

lines.text: Three! Third time's the charm.
Aigoo! Four - 'sa' sounds like death!
Three of us! Lucky, lucky.
Four of us? 'Sa'... someone get off!
Three floors exactly - good things come in threes!
lines.textKo: 딱 세 층 왔네! 역시 삼세번이야~

lines.text: Four floors?! Even the ride says 'sa' - death!
lines.textKo: 네 층이나 탔어?! 타는 것까지 사(死)라니!

lines.text: Thank you, young one.
My knees, dear... is it coming?
I'll take the stairs. Slowly.
New numbers? My mother always said: hide the 4 and death can't find you.
lines.textKo: 숫자를 바꿨네? 우리 어머니가 그러셨지. 4를 가리면 저승사자도 못 찾아온다고.

lines.text: Quickly, quickly! Deals are waiting.
Room for eight? An excellent sign.
Eight for fortune, nine for long life!
Four?! 'Si' sounds like death! Bad for business!
lines.textKo: 4?! 쓰(四)는 죽을 사(死)요! 사업 망하오!

lines.text: Eight of us - full car, full wallet!
lines.textKo: 여덟 명이오! 엘리베이터도 꽉, 지갑도 두둑!

lines.text: Four passengers? 'Si' - terrible for business!
Eight or nine floors - fortune and long life all the way!
Four floors? 'Si' - a deadly journey!
Good service. A lucky tip for you.
Time is money!
Too slow! I take my business elsewhere.
New numbers? A good number is good business.
lines.textKo: 번호를 바꿨소? 좋은 숫자가 곧 좋은 장사요.

lines.text: Hi! Is this the elevator?
Whoa, an elevator operator! So retro.
Seven! Lucky seven, baby!
Floor 13?! Back home, lots of buildings skip it!
lines.textKo: 13층?! 우리 나라엔 13층을 아예 빼는 건물도 많아요!

lines.text: Seven of us - jackpot!
Bit of a crowd, huh?
Seven floors on the dot - lucky seven!
13 floors?! Worst. Ride. Ever.
Awesome! Five stars!
Uh, hello? Anybody driving this thing?
Guess I'll get my steps in.
Ha! You can just... stick a new number on?
Together, please.
We always ride together - that's two of us.
lines.textKo: 저희는 늘 같이 타요. 두 명이에요.

lines.text: Seven! Like the Seven Lucky Gods!
Four is 'shi', nine is 'ku'... death and suffering!
Seven of us? What a blessing!
Four people? 'Shi'... let's not.
Seven floors together - the Seven Lucky Gods smile!
lines.textKo: 둘이서 일곱 층! 칠복신이 웃어 주네요!

lines.text: Four or nine floors - 'shi' or 'ku', either way it's cursed!
lines.textKo: 네 층이든 아홉 층이든, 시(死) 아니면 쿠(苦)... 불길해요!

lines.text: Arigatou! A perfect honeymoon.
Darling, are we waiting forever?
Let's take the stairs... together.
That floor changed its number? How strange.
Casino, please. Seven is my number tonight.
lines.textKo: 카지노로 부탁해요. 오늘 밤 내 숫자는 7이거든요.

lines.text: Lucky seven. I can feel it.
Seven! Let it ride!
Bad omen. Doubling down anyway.
Lucky seven! Jackpot!
Wrong count. The dice hate me.
Seven floors. Lucky seven - the house pays out!
lines.textKo: 일곱 층. 럭키 세븐, 오늘은 카지노가 돈을 토해 낸다!

lines.text: The house always wins? Not tonight.
lines.textKo: 카지노가 늘 이긴다고? 오늘 밤은 아니지.

lines.text: Come on, seven... come on...
Cold streak. I'm out.
New number, new odds. I like it.
Numbers don't lie. Neither should floors.
lines.textKo: 숫자는 거짓말 안 해요. 층도 그래야죠.

lines.text: I'll be checking every floor number.
Six - 'liu liu da shun', all goes smoothly.
This floor does not add up.
Six aboard. The books balance.
That headcount is a rounding error.
Exactly six floors. 'Liu liu da shun' - smooth!
Correct floor, correct number. Thank you.
I am billing you for this wait.
Inefficient. Noted.
A sticker? That's cooking the books!
Bless you, child. Keep me far from the sixes.
Six, six, six is the number of the Beast. Mind every six.
lines.textKo: 육, 육, 육은 짐승의 수라네. 6이란 6은 다 조심하게.

lines.text: Seven - the day the Lord rested. Blessed!
Six! Six, six, six - the number of the Beast!
Seven souls aboard. A holy number.
lines.textKo: 일곱 영혼이 함께 탔군. 거룩한 숫자일세.

lines.text: Six of us? Pray it never becomes six-six-six!
lines.textKo: 여섯 명이라니? 육육육이 되지 않게 기도하게!

lines.text: Seven floors - complete, like the seven days of creation.
lines.textKo: 일곱 층이라. 천지창조의 칠 일처럼 온전한 여정일세.

lines.text: Six floors?! Six, six, six - the Beast rode with us!
lines.textKo: 여섯 층이라니?! 육육육, 짐승이 함께 탔구나!

lines.text: Go in peace, my child.
Patience is a virtue... mine is being tested.
I shall climb toward heaven by the stairs.
Covering a number does not cast out the devil.
Ciao! Anything but 17, eh?
In Italy 13 is lucky - 'fare tredici' means hitting the jackpot!
lines.textKo: 이탈리아에선 13이 행운이야. '13을 맞힌다'는 건 대박이란 뜻이지!

lines.text: 13! Fare tredici - jackpot!
17? Shuffle XVII into VIXI - 'I have lived'. Mamma mia!
13 floors! Fare tredici - I win!
lines.textKo: 열세 층이나 탔어! 13을 맞혔다, 내가 이겼어!

lines.text: 17 floors?! XVII... VIXI, 'I have lived'. I'm finished!
lines.textKo: 열일곱 층이라니?! XVII... VIXI, '나는 살았었다'. 난 끝났어!

lines.text: Grazie mille! Bellissimo.
Ma dai! At my age I have no time to wait!
lines.textKo: 에이 참! 내 나이엔 기다릴 시간이 없다고!

lines.text: Basta! The stairs, like in my village.
A new number? Back home we simply skip the seventeen.
lines.textKo: 번호를 바꿨어? 우리 동네에선 그냥 17을 건너뛰지.

lines.text: Off to a wedding - double happiness tonight!
lines.textKo: 결혼식 가는 길이에요. 오늘은 기쁨이 두 배!

lines.text: Two of us: 'hao shi cheng shuang' - good things come in pairs. Six or eight aboard is even better!
lines.textKo: 두 명이에요. 호사성쌍(好事成雙), 좋은 일은 짝으로 와요. 여섯이나 여덟 명이면 더 좋고요!

lines.text: Eight for fortune, six for smooth sailing - even numbers for a wedding!
Four?! 'Si' sounds like death - not on a wedding day!
lines.textKo: 4?! 쓰(四)는 죽을 사(死)예요. 결혼식 날에 안 돼요!

lines.text: Six or eight of us - an even crowd, double happiness!
lines.textKo: 여섯이나 여덟! 짝수 인원이면 쌍희(雙喜)죠!

lines.text: Four guests? 'Si'... bad luck for the bride!
Six or eight floors - even and lucky, perfect for a wedding!
lines.textKo: 여섯 층이든 여덟 층이든, 짝수라 경사스러워요!

lines.text: Four floors? 'Si'! The banquet is cursed!
A red envelope for you - an even amount, of course!
lines.textKo: 홍바오(紅包) 받으세요. 물론 짝수 금액으로!

lines.text: The banquet will start without us!
We'll walk - together, as a pair.
A new number? As long as it's even - just not 4!
Wedding gift money should be an odd number - 3, 5 or 7.
Odd numbers can't be split in two - so the couple won't split either.
lines.textKo: 홀수는 둘로 나눌 수 없죠. 그러니 부부도 갈라지지 않아요.

lines.text: Three, five, seven - odd and lucky, like a proper wedding gift!
Four is 'shi', nine is 'ku' - never at a wedding!
lines.textKo: 4는 시(死), 9는 쿠(苦)... 결혼식엔 절대 안 돼요!

lines.text: Three, five or seven of us - odd numbers can't be split!
lines.textKo: 셋, 다섯, 일곱! 홀수 인원은 나눠지지 않아요!

lines.text: Four of us? 'Shi'... how inauspicious.
Three, five or seven floors - odd, unbreakable, perfect!
lines.textKo: 세 층, 다섯 층, 일곱 층! 홀수라 깨지지 않아요!

lines.text: Four or nine floors? 'Shi', 'ku' - terrible for a wedding!
lines.textKo: 네 층이든 아홉 층이든... 시(死), 쿠(苦)! 결혼식 날에 끔찍해요!

lines.text: Thank you. Thirty thousand yen in the envelope - odd, of course.
The ceremony starts soon...
The stairs, then. One must never be late to a wedding.
lines.textKo: 계단으로 갈게요. 결혼식엔 늦으면 안 되니까.

lines.text: A new number? I hope it's an odd one.
...Fourth floor. The one you hide.
Don't mind me. I've waited a long time.
Four... out in the open. Too easy.
lines.textKo: 4... 이렇게 다 드러나 있으면, 너무 쉽죠.

lines.text: Not this one.
Four of us now. How fitting.
Four floors. You are learning.
...No. Not this one. The real fourth floor is the hidden one.
You hid the four to keep death out. But hidden floors are where we live. Thank you.
lines.textKo: 죽음을 막으려고 4를 가렸죠. 그런데 가려진 층이 바로 우리가 사는 곳이에요. 고마워요.

lines.text: I can wait. I always have.
...Another night, then.
You can cover a number. It's still there.
Table for one, room for one, ride for one.
11/11 - Singles' Day! Four 1s standing alone like bare sticks. Like me.
lines.textKo: 11월 11일, 솔로의 날! 1 네 개가 막대기처럼 홀로 서 있죠. 저처럼요.

lines.text: A 1! Solo and proud.
A 2? Don't remind me.
Just me - a ride for 1. Perfect.
Two of us... feels like a date. Awkward.
lines.textKo: 둘이 타니까 꼭 데이트 같네요... 어색해.

lines.text: 1 floor or 11 - lonely numbers, lucky me!
lines.textKo: 한 층이든 열한 층이든, 외로운 1이 내 행운!

lines.text: 2 floors. Even the ride came in a pair.
Thanks! I'll treat myself tonight.
lines.textKo: 고마워요! 오늘 밤엔 나한테 한턱 쏴야지.

lines.text: Solo doesn't mean I have all night.
Fine, the stairs. Single file.
A new number? As long as it isn't 2.
Ho ho ho! The roof, please - my sleigh is parked up there.
lines.textKo: 호호호! 옥상으로 가 주겠니? 썰매를 거기 세워 뒀단다.

lines.text: 12 days of Christmas, and the 25th of December. Those are my numbers!
12! Someone's on the nice list.
Hm. I'll check my list twice.
lines.textKo: 흠. 명단을 두 번 확인해 봐야겠군.

lines.text: 12 floors! Like the 12 days of Christmas!
My reindeer fly straighter than this.
Merry Christmas! Here's a little something.
Ho... ho? The children are waiting!
No time! Down the chimney - er, the stairs.
A new number! I love a wrapped surprise.
lines.textKo: 번호가 바뀌었네! 포장된 깜짝 선물 같구나.

lines.text: Fa-la-la-la-la! Three voices, one elevator.
Three voices make a chord - 3 is our lucky number. Just never 4!
lines.textKo: 세 목소리가 모여야 화음이죠. 3은 행운의 숫자! 4만은 안 돼요.

lines.text: 3 - or 12! Our lucky notes, fa-la-la!
4? 'Sa' - like death. Not on Christmas Eve!
Just the three of us - perfect harmony!
Four of us? 'Sa'... one voice too many.
lines.textKo: 넷이요? 사(死)... 목소리 하나가 너무 많아요.

lines.text: 3 floors - or 12! The ride kept perfect time!
lines.textKo: 세 층이든 열두 층이든, 박자가 딱 맞네요!

lines.text: 4 floors - 'sa'! Flat as a cracked bell.
lines.textKo: 네 층이라니, 사(死)! 깨진 종소리 같아요.

lines.text: We wish you a merry Christmas!
Our voices are getting cold!
We'll carol up the stairs instead.
A new number? We'll write a new verse.
